h1: E-Sign PDF Documents Online Without Registration (CS)
description: Place your electronic signature on any PDF file instantly. No account required, no signup, 100% private and free.

sections.title: Sign PDF Documents Instantly Without Creating an Account
sections.content: Annoyed by online sign tools that force you to register, confirm emails, or pay subscriptions just to sign a single paper? HandleMyFile lets you add signatures to contracts completely free without signup.

sections.title: How to Sign PDF Without Signup

steps.title: Upload Document
steps.description: Drop your PDF file into our registration-free workspace.

steps.title: Draw or Type Signature
steps.description: Create your signature with your mouse/touchpad, or upload an image.

steps.title: Download Signed PDF
steps.description: Download your signed document instantly. Zero data is saved.

sections.title: Your Signature is Secure and Stays in Your Browser
sections.content: Biometric and graphical signature drawings are processed entirely in RAM. We do not store your signature or documents on any server, providing maximum fraud prevention.
sections.subTitle: Cryptographically Safe
sections.subContent: Vectors are flattened directly on the client canvas.

sections.title: Frictionless NDA & Contract Signing
sections.content: Perfect for freelancers and business professionals who want to execute agreements, job offers, or NDAs on the spot without any onboarding friction.

sections.title: Sign and Send in 15 Seconds
sections.content: With zero registration forms, email verification, or loading screens, you can sign any document and send it back immediately.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign up or input my email to download?
faqs.a: No. You can download your signed PDF immediately with zero onboarding steps.
Yes, our e-signature complies with general electronic transaction laws for basic electronic signatures.

faqs.q: Does HandleMyFile store my signature graphic?
faqs.a: No. The signature graphics are processed strictly in browser memory and wiped clean on page reload.
